description.narrative: The Initiative FIT! project inSenegal implemented by LuxDev aims to support pathways for young people towards vocational and technical training and employment opportunities across the 14 regions of the country. The FIT! Senegal Initiative is specifically designed to support youth vocational education, training and employment in the context of the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games and for its legacy. Ireland’s contribution will specifically support strengthening the gender equality components of the initiative. Ireland’s contribution will target the integration of women and girls in vocational training and employment opportunities, including through strengthening the capacity of training service providers, supporting women’s access to vocational training, including through combating gender stereotypes, and promoting access for girls and young women to sports facilities created or renovated as part of the Initiative
